name: assets_writeoff_line
description: GH #3889 / REQ-753 (assets C11). One line of a write off of assets (cause writeoff, prefix AWO): one asset card and a quantity. header_id is the record_id of the assets_writeoff header; the foreign key promotes it to a uuid column with ON DELETE RESTRICT. org_unit_id is the header's value copied by the module (scope column). Written only by module assets; after issue nothing of a line changes.
